instruction: I have a spreadsheet with research papers on my desktop. Count how many papers were published in 2018 and save the count as a text file named "count_2018.txt" in the /home/user directory.

metadata.explanation: Verified with Python: 3 papers published in 2018 (BERT, GLUE, Deep Contextualized Word Representations). Evaluator reads the count from the text file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Reads the file at /home/user/count_2018.txt and extracts the first number using regex, with proper error handling
Metric logic is correct: Compares result number with expected value (3) using exact integer match
Parameter handling is correct: Metric function correctly accesses expected.get('value') for type='rule', not expected.get('rules')
Expected value is correct: Verified count of 3 papers published in 2018 (BERT, GLUE, Deep Contextualized Word Representations)
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both requirements - file saved at correct path and contains correct count
Robust error handling: Getter returns 0 on file not found, decode errors, or no numbers found
